claims: N03's GroupClock, built for soft-float big-endian MIPS32r2 (mips-unknown-linux-musl) and run as PID 1, decides exactly as the independent Python reference does on all 30 scripted worlds of tests/n03/vectors.json (1,839 records) and byte-for-byte as the host build of the same source file does.
Two seeded simulated worlds, whose LCG seeds derive from a per-run seed the host packs into the initramfs, match the reference's figures: a replayed or canned transcript cannot carry them.

Guest instructions for a steady stream of exchanges (next_probe + on_response) and for the per-block gate path (tick, local_for_group, output), read from the CP0 Count through a ruler calibrated in the same boot.

commands.boot_and_judge_with_replay_plant: FFW_BUILD_DIR=<kernel cache> python3 toolchain/src/measure-n03-target.py run --elf <elf> --log-dir <fresh dir> --host-log <host log> --revision e77f24d287776a5c958871b506e14af2553e0a75 --plant replay
commands.boot_and_judge_with_truncate_plant: FFW_BUILD_DIR=<kernel cache> python3 toolchain/src/measure-n03-target.py run --elf <elf> --log-dir <fresh dir> --host-log <host log> --revision e77f24d287776a5c958871b506e14af2553e0a75 --plant truncate
commands.note: The seeds are in each run entry. The ELF is not committed (its sha256 is above): rebuild it from the recorded sources, or supply the same bytes. The plant-replay transcript is judged under its own seed; plant-truncate under run 2's.

elf.build_command: cd <snapshot> && RCH_CANONICAL_PROJECT_ROOT=<snapshot> RCH_REQUIRE_REMOTE=1 RCH_WORKER=<worker> CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<snapshot>/build/n03-target-target rch exec --worker <worker> -- cargo +nightly build --offline --release --manifest-path toolchain/src/n03-target/Cargo.toml --target mips-unknown-linux-musl -Z build-std=core,alloc,std,panic_abort --config 'target.mips-unknown-linux-musl.linker="<snapshot>/toolchain/linker/zig-cc-mips-be"' --config 'target.mips-unknown-linux-musl.rustflags=["-C","target-feature=+crt-static","-C","link-self-contained=no"]' -j 2
build_warnings: assembler: used $at without .set noat (also present in the D03 guest build; the ruler's shape-agreement gate would fail if it had added an instruction to a calibration loop)
linker: library directory not found (expected with link-self-contained=no)
elf.name: ffw-n03-target
elf.snapshot: git archive of the repository head above plus the guest crate; the snapshot's Cargo.lock is the repository's
elf.toolchain: nightly with rust-src; `rustc -vV` was not captured for this build

evidence_class: host simulation: QEMU TCG with -icount, a 24Kf MIPS model. Not hardware.

host_digests.log_not_committed: the full log carries worker names and local paths; only its 30 N03-TARGET-HOST records are kept
host_digests.source: cargo test -p franken-clock --test n03_target_worlds -- --nocapture (6 tests), central run on the revision above, exit 0

judge.mutation_checks: 21 of 21 deliberate breakages of a judge check are caught by the named test (scratch-copy sweep)
judge.reference: tests/n03/reference.py through tests/n03/run_cases.py judge_world (re-derives the expectation at judge time)

not_covered: Cycles on a real core: QEMU icount counts executed instructions only; no cache, pipeline, memory-latency or multiplier timing.
A board clock: the repository records none for any MIPS board, so no percentage of a CPU is claimed.
DAC, acoustic or analog alignment: the clock is a network-clock fit only (every report says so).
Real network delay, a real timer resolution, suspend and resume: every world is scripted or simulated.
PowerPC boards (hard-float, a different ISA): no run.
N03 is not closed by this receipt; ffw-u07 has other open clauses and the independent verifier closes it.

qemu.command: qemu-system-mips -M malta -cpu 24Kf -m 64M -nographic -no-reboot -icount shift=0,align=off,sleep=off -kernel <kernel> -initrd <initramfs> -append "console=ttyS0,38400 rdinit=/init panic=-1 loglevel=3"
qemu.initramfs: toolchain/src/mkinitramfs.py: the ELF as /init plus the per-run seed as /ffw_seed (plant-replay also /plant-replay and /replay)
